cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')

supporting_source_lines.snippet:
String query = "SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name = '" + userName + "'";
        return statement.executeQuery(query);

root_cause: The SQL command is built by concatenating a caller-supplied name into the query string.
explanation: This teaching sample uses Statement.executeQuery on a string-built SELECT. The Assignment 1 regex rule sql_string_concat matches that pattern and maps it to CWE-89.
remediation: Use a PreparedStatement with a placeholder and bind userName as a parameter.
